protocol_notes: Each offered-load condition used one warmup and three measured attempts, sequentially, with the same release CLI binary and SHA-256-checked inputs.
Generation, compilation, resource monitoring and post-run verification are outside the GNU time child scope. Simulator preparation, simulation and standard output publication are inside it.
The process address-space cap is 26 GiB, RSS protection is 24 GiB, minimum host available memory is 3 GiB; incomplete runs never establish an unconstrained peak RSS or completion duration.
A separate monitor terminates still-running attempts after an observed 180 seconds. Its per-attempt record establishes a lower bound on completion time; termination is not successful publication.
Per-process core-file limit1 suppresses the WSL crash-capture pipe. Preliminary trials with core limit0 were excluded because crash capture stalled after allocator failure.
This is a WSL2 environment series. Native baseline and cross-environment equivalence were not tested.
